# compound commands mixing safe linux and safe github commands
gh pr list && ls -la
ls -la && gh pr list
gh issue list | grep open
pwd ; gh repo view
gh pr view 1 && cat file.txt && gh issue status

# compound commands mixing safe jira with safe linux / github commands
jira issue list | grep open
jira issue view PROJ-1 && ls -la
pwd ; jira sprint list
jira issue list && gh pr list

# redirection on the last segment of a mixed line
gh repo view && ls > out.txt
gh repo view && ls>out.txt
ls -la && gh pr view 42 > out.txt
gh repo view > out.txt && ls
ls>out.txt && gh repo view
